scope: Development follow-up to the completed R6 continuous-state pair. This is not held-out capability, retention, or multistage acceptance.
terminalGoal: Original smoke development goal self position.2 < -5.5. Does not replace the original natural-world task goal < -14.5.
change: Only the real-clock live path defers preparation-callback theta fitting until executeOffer returns or throws. Every actual frame still enters z before the exact start prediction. Complete original passive windows and their original branded state traces are learned in order before any later passive/action outcome; duplicates remain rejected. Record the actual theta version used at authorization and deferred original window IDs. Legacy unclocked adapters retain their existing update ordering.
tradeoff: The start prediction intentionally uses theta from before the deferred preparation windows while conditioning on the exact up-to-date real z. This is a changed learning schedule, not an identical-model speed benchmark. All original parameter writes are retained after the attempt, so subsequent model trajectories and sampled outcomes can differ from R6.
fixed: actual motor holds and release/stabilization behavior
100/50 ms search budgets and node limits
startGate: Complete software integration must pass and source must be committed. Freeze a new actor and verify all files, source/world/session/goal bytes, both original initial-model digests, dependencies, log hashes and successful exit code in launch-pins before the first launch.
stopAndAudit: No concurrent CPU experiments. Preserve every outcome and overrun, stop under the original decision/time bounds, archive the stopped world, then run capture/frame-state/freshness/coverage and frozen-parameter equality audits. Only after the first stopped run's integrity permits it run the registered frozen pair. An integrity failure retains the attempt and requires a separately registered corrected actor, never an invisible retry.
measures: execution and refusal counts over all 32 decisions
callback validation, real-frame processing, prediction, and deferred fitting durations separately
original deferred window IDs and exact theta write delta
all raw frame clocks, edges, source bindings, gaps and consumption watermarks
theta/affordance equality when frozen; actual window writes when online
supported executed forecast coverage and actual goal state
source/model/world hashes, RSS, state/checkpoint bytes and original stopped raw evidence
interpretation: R6 baseline is 0/32 online executed and 14/32 frozen, no supported execution or goal success. Higher execution alone only indicates improved availability. This follow-up cannot establish useful prediction, history dependence, retention, timed rollout, learned prerequisite composition or sustained autonomy. Continue engineering and meaningful native tests until those remaining objectives are handled.
